thread:
anya: Quick sync — we need a compact inventory of generation API corner cases for the PRD. Scope: streaming, truncation, token limits, retries. Keep it consumable for Q2 launch criteria.

mike: I'll start: streaming cases — (1) connection drop + resume leads to duplicated tokens; (2) mid-stream model restart -> missing trailing tokens; (3) partial JSON in stream -> invalid parse. AC: resume must be idempotent, stream includes finality markers.

jordan: Token limits: (1) prompt+response > context -> clear deterministic failure (no partial text); (2) model truncates mid-function-call; (3) mixed-context (embeds + long prompt) miscount. AC: standardized "context_overflow" error code + no body emitted. Example error: {"error": "context_overflow", "message": "prompt+response exceed model context"}.

sophia: Truncation specifics: (1) server-side new_token cutoff due to max_new_tokens -> must signal truncated=true; (2) client truncation of long prompts that breaks structured instructions -> warning when detected; (3) truncation inside function-call args -> must surface a validation flag. AC: SDK surfaces a meta object with truncation indicators.

samir: Retries and side-effects: repeated retries can cause duplicate downstream actions (DB writes, webhooks). AC: default retry policy for non-idempotent routes = disabled; recommend idempotency keys and career docs.

anya: Add interplay cases: streaming + token limits (client sees partial stream then gets context_overflow), streaming + retries (retries that replay content -> duplicates), streaming + function-calls (stream cuts inside call). Need acceptance test for each combined case.

mike: Operational requirement: resume tokens must be stable across model variants used for fallback. Also sequence numbers per request to avoid reordering when batching changes throughput.

jordan: Test harness items: simulate TCP drop, inject KV-cache delays, fuzz prompt lengths and token accounting. Create synthetic traces for CI.

sophia: SDK proposal snippet: response.meta = {"truncated": "bool", "resume_token": "string|null", "context_usage": "int"}. SDK should expose helpers: resume(token) and isTruncated().

samir: Customer ask: enterprise preference for auto-fallback to smaller model vs explicit failure on truncation. Decision: make fallback policy configurable per deployment and document safety tradeoffs.

anya: Launch checklist (short): 1) PRD bullets + acceptance criteria in repo; 2) SDK changes spec + example; 3) 10 synthetic scenarios in CI passing; 4) beta with 2 customers; 5) canary+rollback plan. Any objections?

mike: none, +1

jordan: +1

sophia: +1

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled 2026-04-02T18:00Z :rocket:

anya: Owners: streaming=mike, truncation=sophia, retries=samir, tests=jordan. I'll author the PRD and link it here.

mike: INF-3421 created: streaming resume semantics + ordering guarantees.

sophia: INF-3422 created: truncation flags + SDK surface.

jordan: INF-3423 created: test harness + fuzz jobs.

samir: INF-3424 created: retry policy + customer config.

anya: Thanks — i'll convert bullets into the PRD and tag owners. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
